About Me

Design Meets Development

I'm a UI/UX Designer and Frontend Developer with a genuine passion for both disciplines. Where most designers stop at mockups, I carry work all the way to production — writing the HTML, CSS, and JavaScript myself.

My design thinking is rooted in user-centered principles: I start with research and personas, move through wireframes and prototyping in Figma, then iterate based on usability testing. On the development side, I build responsive, accessible interfaces using React and modern CSS.

I'm actively exploring the intersection of AI and UX — using generative tools like Midjourney, Framer AI, and Adobe Firefly to accelerate creative exploration while keeping human intent at the center.

Currently seeking a dual design-and-code internship where I can contribute across the full product lifecycle.
